views.label: All
views.note: One native Android app: the Compose feature surface, the Gradle modules under it, the device stores, the systems it talks to.

views.label: Auth
views.note: Credential Manager or AppAuth + Custom Tabs with PKCE; the token is sealed by Keystore + Tink; the server decides what the app may do.

views.label: Offline
views.note: The mutation lands in a Room outbox row; WorkManager drains it with an idempotency key; the server resolves the conflict.

views.label: Release
views.note: One variant = one binary; R8 full mode plus a baseline profile; push is a channel, not a data path.

boundaries.label: The app process — one variant = one application module = one binary
Credential plane — Keystore + Tink only; never Room, DataStore, logs or the APK

cards.title: The architecture contract
items: the Gradle module graph is the enforcement: a module's dependencies {} is the complete list of what it may import, so a forbidden edge is a compile error
domain modules apply the Kotlin/JVM plugin, not the Android plugin — an android.* import there does not compile; the data module implements the ports the domain declares
UDF is the only presentation contract: UiState down, UiEvent up, one-shot effects on a separate channel; the ViewModel never holds a Context, a View or a composable
:apps:<variant> is the composition root, the navigation host and the DI wiring — one variant = one application module = one binary, so the market app carries no game engine

cards.title: The three skills and the lints
items: android-best-practices loads whenever an agent writes or changes an Android app and carries the digests in references/ (android.md, compose-patterns.md, android-architecture.md, kotlin-strict.md)
android-review writes a prioritized report where every finding cites the rule it breaks and shows the smallest fix; a broken architecture contract is an automatic Must fix
android-port ports a React Native, web, Java/XML Views or legacy screen to Kotlin + Compose, porting the original tests first
lints/detekt.yml and lints/.editorconfig are the machine-checkable half: maxIssues 0, warningsAsErrors, InjectDispatcher, GlobalCoroutineUsage, RedundantSuspendModifier

cards.title: Secrets and the server
items: secrets live in Keystore + Tink — never in SharedPreferences, Room, logs or the APK; a token in SharedPreferences is a breach on a shared device
the server is authoritative for game state, prices, payments and entitlements; root, emulator and Play Integrity are server-side risk signals, never a client block
FCM is a channel, not a data path: the payload is { v, type, id, route } and the tap goes through the same deep-link parser as any other link

cards.title: Offline, gates and CI
items: the outbox is a Room table drained by WorkManager with an idempotency key, backoff and a dead-letter view; a conflict is resolved by the server and the local change is rejected visibly
CI runs scripts/check-lints.sh (detekt over the clean control and the violation harness), scripts/check-build.sh (Gradle test + detekt of the example) and scripts/check-examples.py
detekt InjectDispatcher makes a hard-coded Dispatchers.IO a finding; a module-wide @Suppress or a grown baseline is a finding, not a fix
